_comment: Hero pine variant A. Visual source = the four loaded pine variants in assets/world/trees/low_poly_forest_tree_pack/. The archetype id MUST match the variant_name set by TreeAssets::collectTreeMeshesFromGltf (canonicalHeroVariantName: pine_a / pine_b / pine_c / pine_short) so the prop spawn funnel resolves the variant correctly. Examine fields are shared across all pine variants -- the cosmological lesson is about the wood (it died long ago), not about any specific variant. insight_trigger_subject='tree' so all pine examines fire the same insight node (knows_wood_long_dead).
